I have drafted a set of question-answer (QA) variants based on target and neighbor fact-topic pairs. For the Onvo L90, I created four options with the expected answer. Similarly, I've crafted a parallel set of four for the Li i8. These prompts will undergo further refinement to ensure diversity and relevance.
